scenes.heading: Maven Modules & Package Types (Part 2 of 2)
scenes.narration: Env Setup. Maven Modules & Package Types (Part 2 of 2). In this video we review 5 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What configuration must all packages except 'all' have so Cloud Manager ignores them?
scenes.heading: cloudManagerTarget set to none
scenes.body: All packages except the `all` container package must have `<cloudManagerTarget>none</cloudManagerTarget>` in their package configuration. This tells Cloud Manager to ignore them — only the `all` package is deployed.

scenes.question: Which Maven module holds OSGi configurations and Repo Init scripts?
scenes.heading: ui.config
scenes.body: `ui.config` contains OSGi run mode configurations (`.cfg.json` files) and Repo Init scripts. OSGi configs in `ui.config` are scoped by run mode — they activate only for the matching environment (e.g., author, publish, dev, prod).

scenes.question: How many key Maven modules does a standard AEM project have?
scenes.heading: Five key modules
scenes.body: A standard AEM project has five key Maven modules: `core` (Java OSGi bundle), `ui.apps` (code package → /apps), `ui.content` (content package → /content, /conf), `ui.config` (OSGi configs + Repo Init), and `all` (container package deployed by Cloud Manager).

scenes.question: What does the 'all' package embed?
scenes.heading: All other Maven modules: core bundle, ui.apps, ui.content, ui.config
scenes.body: The `all` package embeds all other modules: the `core` OSGi bundle, the `ui.apps` code package, the `ui.content` content package, and the `ui.config` configuration package. When Cloud Manager deploys `all`, it installs everything.

scenes.question: Which package type is used for code packages like ui.apps that deploy to immutable paths?
scenes.heading: application
scenes.body: The `application` package type is assigned to code packages like `ui.apps` that deploy to immutable repository paths (`/apps`). AEMaaCS uses the package type to enforce immutability — `application` packages cannot write to mutable paths at runtime.
